verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the GitHub project, which says its implementations support HOTP (RFC 4226) as well as TOTP (RFC 6238), so counter-based tokens are covered. Nothing in the pack addresses Steam Guard, custom periods or non-default digit lengths, and the support docs never mention non-standard token types. Missing for 10: Steam Guard support, custom period configuration, custom digit-length support, first-party app docs confirming HOTP in the current app, hands-on corroboration.
